g.title: Controls broker connections and order routing by managing the active broker session, dispatching orders to the appropriate broker adapter, and handling execution callbacks and circuit breaker logic.
Integrates with the Alpaca brokerage API for live trading, submitting orders, streaming execution updates, and reconciling account positions with the Alpaca platform.
Simulates broker order execution for paper trading, accepting orders and generating realistic fill, reject, and partial-fill events without connecting to a real brokerage.
Manages the order staging lifecycle by receiving approved decisions, staging orders for market-open execution, and coordinating with broker services for order submission and status tracking.
Routes execution domain events to the investor, ledger, and advisory domains, forwarding order status, deposit and withdrawal completions, and reconciliation signals across domain boundaries.
